title: Finite-projection normalization of an integral coefficient comparison
statement: Use the integral coefficient presentations, finite-label functors $F_X,G_X$, finite quotient tower $(T_n)$ and comparisons $\rho_{a,n}$ of [def-sfb-integral-comparison-coefficients]. For an isomorphism of abelian sheaves $e:p_X^*\Lambda_E\simeq B_{E,X}$, define the integral comparison normalization as follows. Both $e$ and $e^{-1}$ preserve the ring-object unit and multiplication. There exist a natural isomorphism $a:F_X\simeq G_X$, a limit cone $c$ over the profinite tower $(T_n)$, and a profinite isomorphism $j:\mathcal O_E\simeq c_{\mathrm{pt}}$ such that $(c_n\circ j)(x)=x\bmod\pi_E^{n+1}$ for every $n\in\mathbf N$ and $x\in\mathcal O_E$. For every profinite set $S$, continuous $g:S\to\mathcal O_E$, and $n\in\mathbf N$, the section obtained by applying the point-adjunction unit to $g$, then $e$, then the $n$th completed-coefficient projection, and then $\rho_{a,n}$, is the morphism $X[S]\to X[T_n]$ induced by $c_n\circ j\circ g$. This is a predicate on an already specified isomorphism, with no assertion that one exists.
